items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I’ve heard people say, “Wasn’t James Reese Europe the first person to put jazz on record?”

ctx.x: Could have had that historical distinction.

Yeah. It would have been nice. And this controversy too, I’ve heard people say, “Wasn’t James Reese Europe the first person to put jazz on record?” I had a guy pigeonhole me. We were on some panel together and he got me in a corner and he was pushing hard. And he said, “Come on you have to agree with me that James Reese Europe was the first —” I just said, “Listen man, I know what you’re trying to do. I know you don’t like the fact that the ODJB, a white group, was the first.” This happened to be a black Muslim…
They’re corny. Well you’ve got to think of the time it was but we know now it wasn’t the real thing that could have been captured.
